briefdescription.para: Phase 2/3 Geo Module Integration - Coordinates hardening components.

detaileddescription.para: Focused acceptance tests for Geo Module Phase 2/3 hardening.

This module coordinates the integration of Phase 2/3 hardening components (backend dispatch timeout enforcement, geometry validation, spatial index contract verification, and unified diagnostics) with the existing geo module.
Roadmap reference: src/geo/ROADMAP.md §"Phase 2 & Phase 3" FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS reference: src/geo/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md
This module consolidates the hardening work for:

listitem.para: Backend dispatch determinism: ensure GPU/CPU fallback is silent, result-consistent, and bounded (≤100µs)
Geometry internals: strengthen coordinate validation, ring closure, minimum vertices
Spatial index contracts: verify insert durability, bounding-box consistency, concurrent safety
Fail-closed behavior: all invalid geometry → explicit GeoErrorCode, no silent degradation
Unified diagnostics: consolidated error messages across join/clustering/raster/temporal paths
Diagnostic helpers: actionable errors for backend fallback and capability drift incidents

detaileddescription.para: Roadmap reference: src/geo/ROADMAP.md §"Phase 2 & Phase 3" FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS reference: src/geo/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md §"Implementation Notes"

Tests verify:
Phase 2 (Core): backend dispatch timeout enforcement, geometry validation, spatial index contracts
Phase 3 (Error Handling): fail-closed behavior, unified diagnostics, error recovery

Test naming convention: P23-NN (Phase 2/3, test number 01-16) P23-01..P23-04: Backend dispatch timeout enforcement P23-05..P23-08: Geometry validation integration P23-09..P23-12: Fallback metrics accuracy P23-13..P23-16: Spatial index contract verification
